clauses.name: Logos, the Lost
clauses.printedParagraph:
· When you win a confrontation, you may choose a target manifestation in an Interzone and put it into stalemate. That manifestation cannot change zone until the end of the turn.
· When you lose a confrontation, Logos and a target manifestation among those that won the confrontation enter into stalemate. Both cannot change zone until the end of the turn.
clauses.expectedBehavior: The printed live-card target accepts exactly one authoritative card on the field and enforces its declared card type, field zone, controller, confrontation outcome and power threshold. The Stalemate Zone is excluded unless named, stale or malformed targets are rejected without mutation, and a valid target begins the printed card-specific result.
